name: Carlos Gomez
learned: Carlos Gomez is a high school student at Grade 12. He likes to write poems in his spare time to explore his inner thoughts and feelings. He is always looking for new ways to express himself.
currently: Carlos Gomez is working on a collection of poetry that explores the beauty of the school. He is also keen to communicate with Ayesha Khan to hone his skills.
lifestyle: Carlos Gomez goes to bed around 10pm, awakes up around 7am, eats dinner around 5pm.
